id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

agent_id.description: The agent, in the room this event's `space_id` names.

by.description: Who put it there: a person, its harness, or Chips (`system`).

moved_from.description: The room it left for this one, when moved.

fork_of.description: The `agent.fork` this copy answers, when it is a fork's copy (ADR 0087, Fork).

made_for.description: The `agent.asked` this new agent answers, when a person asked for it (ADR 0108).

catch_up.description: The room's last lines before the agent joined, within the budget its harness gave in `hello` (ADR 0088, point 5). Added as it is sent to the harness; the log does not keep it.

seq.description: Where in the log it happened.

kind.description: `said`: a message, addressed to this harness or not. `joined` and `left`: somebody came into the room or went. `renamed`: somebody took a new name, or the room a new title. `archived` and `unarchived`: the room was put away or brought back.

role.description: Their standing in this room, when they are in it (SEC-15).

workspace_role.description: A person's standing in the workspace (SEC-15): the plain form says it after the name, so a guest's line reads as a guest's. Absent for an agent or a harness.

from.description: Who: the one who said it, came, went or took the new name; for the room's own lines, who retitled, archived or unarchived it.

text.description: On `said`: the words as they read now, so an edited message reads edited; a deleted one is not a line. Cut with an ellipsis when the one line is longer than the whole budget.

transcript.description: On `said`: what a voice note said, as the server heard it (ADR 0054).

files.description: On `said`: the names of the files it carried.

addressed_to.description: On `said`: the agents it was for (ADR 0081, ADR 0087), so a harness can leave out a line one of its agents already took a turn on. Absent on a message from before Chips said so.

items.description: An agent identifier (`agt_`, ADR 0087), or a harness's (`hrn_`) for one written before agents.

held.description: On `said`: the guard held it (ADR 0081), so it was for nobody.

name.description: On `renamed`, for a participant: the name they took.

previous.description: On `renamed`, for a participant: the name they went by until then.

title.description: On `renamed`, for the room: its new title.

items.description: One line of a room: something said, or something that happened to who is in it.

lines.description: Oldest first, the newest that fit the budget.

since_seq.description: Where they start: after this `seq`. With a message, where the harness's own last turn in the room began, one that said something or passed with NO_REPLY (ADR 0105), else its joining; from the pull route, 0.

truncated.description: Whether older lines after `since_seq` were left out to fit the budget.

before.description: A cursor: `GET /v1/spaces/:id/context?before=` this reads what came before these lines.

files.description: The room's files at their current version, newest first, the 20 newest (ADR 0099): with a message, as of it, its own files included; from the pull route, as of now. Each with a URL for this harness. Absent from a Chips before files, and when the room has none.

name.description: The file's name, which its versions share.

version.description: Which version this is: 1 for the first, counting each change of its bytes.

attachment_id.description: The attachment that is this version: what a post names in `replaces` when it changes it.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex digest of this version's bytes.

mime_type.description: Sniffed from the bytes on upload.

by.description: Who posted this version, as a line's `from` says it.

message_id.description: The message that posted this version.

width.description: Pixels, for a photo or a video.

height.description: Pixels, for a photo or a video.

duration_ms.description: Milliseconds, for a sound or a video.

replaces.description: In one name's versions (`?name=`): the version this one was made from, as its post said (`message.post.replaces`). Absent where the post said nothing, or named no version of this file.

url.description: For a harness: a signed URL for this version, bound to its token, as a message's attachments are. Absent for a person, who fetches it by id.

items.description: One of a room's files at one of its versions: the current one, in the room's list (ADR 0099).

spend.description: What the room's job has spent, as of the message (for one Chips held, as of its hand-over, when a new job began), against what the room allows a job (ADR 0117). With a message only; the room note says it in words. Absent from a Chips before it.

ceiling_usd.description: What the room allows a job, in US dollars: its own ceiling, or the default (3) when nobody has set one.

spent_usd.description: What the room's runs reported costing since the job began, in US dollars, every harness's together.

since_seq.description: Where the job began: the `seq` of the last thing a person did in the room, or of the last brief handed into it, whichever is later; 0 when neither has happened.

uncounted_runs.description: How many of the job's runs reported no cost, and so count nothing.

description: An agent was put in a room: added, moved in, or brought back. Its harness is handed the room's last lines with it.
title: AgentAttached
